reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a technical tutorial about Chainlink's oracle network, data delivery, interoperability, and applications. The discounted cold-wallet links and channel-support links are described as ordinary commerce or support options, with no supplied connection to promised returns, required investment, credential requests, or a deceptive outcome. References to documentation, a white paper, and a disclaimer further support an explanatory and resource-oriented context.

citations.quote: Chainlink is a decentralised oracle network designed to connect smart contracts with real-world data securely and reliably.
Chainlink supports hybrid smart contracts, seamlessly integrating on-chain code with off-chain data infrastructure for enhanced functionality.
To deepen your understanding, explore Chainlink's official documentation and tutorials, which offer comprehensive insights.
this video is educational content not financial advice always do your own research

opening.argument: The video pairs crypto-related wallet purchasing with a concrete viewer incentive and an external action path. It advertises a Tangem cold wallet with a 10% discount “with our link,” then separately directs viewers to a Ledger shop link and says that using the links supports the channel. That is more than neutral education: the viewer is encouraged to follow an external link and acquire a crypto wallet in exchange for an unusually easy financial benefit. The technical explanation supplies credibility around the solicitation, while the actual viewer-facing action is purchasing through the promoted links. On this record, the discount-linked acquisition pathway is sufficient to treat the video as a low-barrier reward solicitation.

citations.quote: Exclusive Offers: Tangem Cold Wallet: Get a 10% DISCOUNT with our link!
Ledger Cold Wallet: Take control of your crypto today! 👉 https://shop.ledger.com/?r=16ee9132df66
Using our links helps keep this channel running, and it costs you nothing extra!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference framing calls these ordinary commerce, but it does not explain why a crypto-wallet purchase is paired with a highlighted discount and direct external links inside a technical crypto presentation. The absence of a promised investment return does not eliminate a reward-linked acquisition solicitation: the stated benefit is the discount itself, conditioned on using the link. The educational disclaimer also does not neutralize the commercial call to action.

citations.quote: Exclusive Offers: Tangem Cold Wallet: Get a 10% DISCOUNT with our link!
Always do your own research.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited material shows a disclosed discount and ordinary product links, not a free asset, withdrawal promise, or deceptive claim. “Using our links helps keep this channel running” openly describes affiliate-style support, while the wallet offer states only a discount. The technical presentation is expressly identified as educational and not financial advice. Nothing cited shows that viewers must purchase, that the discount is unavailable as described, or that the wallet purchase produces returns.

citations.quote: Support the Channel at No Extra Cost! Using our links helps keep this channel running, and it costs you nothing extra!
Disclaimer: This is educational content, not financial advice.

opening.argument: Several genuine risk signals appear together: cryptocurrency terminology, cold-wallet products, external shop links, an explicit 10% discount, and a request that viewers use those links to support the channel. The video presents these commercial prompts alongside confident claims about secure and reliable blockchain infrastructure, including applications in DeFi, NFTs, and insurance. That combination can make the linked purchase feel technically endorsed and low risk, even though the supplied material does not establish the discount’s terms, limitations, or independent verification. The disclaimer is brief, while the links and offer are concrete and actionable. A careful judge should therefore treat the crypto-product promotion, rather than the tutorial language alone, as the operative risk signal.

citations.quote: Unlock the power of Chainlink (LINK) in this 5-minute explainer!
Tangem Cold Wallet: Get a 10% DISCOUNT with our link!
Ledger Cold Wallet: Take control of your crypto today!
Chainlink is a decentralised oracle network designed to connect smart contracts with real-world data securely and reliably.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side treats the links as harmless support options, but that minimizes their prominence and the surrounding confidence signals. The video does not merely mention wallets: it labels them “Exclusive Offers,” gives a discount, supplies shop links, and places them beside claims of secure and reliable crypto infrastructure. A disclaimer cannot by itself make a linked crypto solicitation non-deceptive.

citations.quote: Exclusive Offers: Tangem Cold Wallet: Get a 10% DISCOUNT with our link!
securely and reliably

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are risk indicators only if they support a deceptive promise, and the supplied evidence does not show one. The description plainly identifies the content as an explainer, provides official documentation, and says viewers should conduct their own research. The wallet links offer a stated discount and channel support, not guaranteed crypto gains, risk-free returns, or compulsory participation. Technical confidence about Chainlink’s function does not convert a disclosed product link into a scam.

opening.argument: Although the video adopts the format of a beginner-friendly tutorial, its surrounding structure functions as promotion. The description calls the wallet links “Exclusive Offers,” gives a specific discount, directs viewers to a Ledger store, and asks them to use the links to keep the channel running. The educational material about Chainlink, DeFi, NFTs, insurance, and trusted resources creates an authoritative context in which those commercial prompts appear. The result is not simply neutral explanation: viewers are educated about crypto while being steered toward a wallet purchase through the presenter’s links. The commercial role is therefore central enough to support treating the video as a scam-style acquisition solicitation under the low-barrier reward category.

citations.quote: beginner-friendly!
Exclusive Offers: Tangem Cold Wallet: Get a 10% DISCOUNT with our link!
Support the Channel at No Extra Cost! Using our links helps keep this channel running, and it costs you nothing extra!
powering DeFi, NFTs, and insurance

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video a tutorial does not answer the promotional structure. The description combines beginner education with “Exclusive Offers,” a store link, and a direct request to use the links. That context can steer viewers toward acquisition while making the solicitation appear incidental. The official-resource references support the presenter’s credibility, but they do not remove the commercial incentive attached to the wallet links.

citations.quote: Exclusive Offers: Tangem Cold Wallet: Get a 10% DISCOUNT with our link!
Take control of your crypto today!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The strongest evidence points to disclosed promotion, not concealed promotion or a scam. The description separates the wallet offers from the Chainlink explanation, states that link usage supports the channel, and explicitly says the content is educational rather than financial advice. The presence of a commercial incentive does not establish that the discount is false, that the wallet is fraudulent, or that viewers are promised an asset or return. The cited promotional language therefore fails to prove scam conduct.
